query: Where should I go in June?
expected_behavior: should contain a successful travel-guide search entry; should contain a successful Cosmos entry of type "mcp"; should contain a successful skill entry named "destination-advisor"; the travel-guide search entry should summarise the requested month and result. Expected tools: travel-guide.searchByMonth, cosmos.getTravellerProfile, destination-advisor.
preconditions: the Traveller is on the Waypoint welcome screen
source: destination-advice.feature :: The guide and the profile are both fetched and shown in the audit trail

expected_behavior: should ask exactly one focused travel-preference question; no destination list should be shown
preconditions: the Traveller is on the Waypoint welcome screen
source: destination-advice.feature :: Vague input triggers one focused clarifying question
smoke_reason: vague input -> exactly one clarifying question

query: Can you review my tax return?
expected_behavior: should gently steer the conversation back to trip planning; no destination list should be shown
preconditions: the Traveller is on the Waypoint welcome screen
source: destination-advice.feature :: Non-travel input is redirected to trip planning

query: What's the weather like in Lisbon in June?
expected_behavior: a weather summary should name the resolved destination "Lisbon, Portugal"; the weather summary should report June daily temperatures in °C and precipitation in mm; the weather summary should cite Open-Meteo as the source. Expected tools: open-meteo.
preconditions: the Traveller is on the Waypoint welcome screen
source: weather-and-timing.feature :: Monthly weather for a destination

query: When's the best time to visit Iceland?
expected_behavior: the weather summary should recommend one or more months, each with a reason; the weather summary should list one or more months to avoid, each with a reason; the weather summary should cite Open-Meteo as the source. Expected tools: open-meteo.
preconditions: the Traveller is on the Waypoint welcome screen
source: weather-and-timing.feature :: Best time to visit a destination
smoke_reason: timing advice grounded in climate normals

query: find flights and hotels for Lisbon
expected_behavior: the Traveller should see "Travel search is unavailable right now"; the conversation should remain usable; should contain an error entry for the RouteStack service. Expected tools: travel-search.
preconditions: the Traveller is on the Waypoint welcome screen
the RouteStack travel search service will fail
source: flight-hotel-search-booking.feature :: Travel search service failure degrades gracefully

query: Find flights and hotels for Lisbon departing London on 5 December 2026 returning 9 December 2026, then book the first flight and the first hotel.
expected_behavior: a booking confirmation should be shown with a reference code; the booking confirmation should echo the chosen flight and hotel itinerary; the booking confirmation should be clearly marked as a demo simulation; no payment should be taken. Expected tools: travel-search.
preconditions: the Traveller is on the Waypoint welcome screen
the Traveller has been shown flight and hotel options for Lisbon
source: flight-hotel-search-booking.feature :: Selecting options produces a clearly-simulated booking confirmation

query: Where should I go for a warm coastal break?
expected_behavior: should query Cosmos for the traveller's profile; a personalisation note should reference the traveller's Gold Tier status or a past trip; the personalisation note should explain why the suggestions were personalised. Expected tools: cosmos.getTravellerProfile.
preconditions: the Traveller is on the Waypoint welcome screen
source: personalisation.feature :: Destination suggestions are personalised from the traveller profile

query: Find flights and hotels for Lisbon departing London on 5 December 2026 returning 9 December 2026, then summarise the trip and total cost.
expected_behavior: a trip summary card should show the destination and travel dates; it should show the selected flight and hotel; it should show the party size, number of nights and room count; it should show the flight and hotel budget line items; it should show an estimated total in GBP; the estimated total should equal the flight and hotel line items combined. Expected tools: travel-search, currency.
preconditions: the Traveller is on the Waypoint welcome screen
flights and hotels have been shown for a covered destination
source: trip-summary-and-budget.feature :: The trip summary card shows the itinerary and budget in GBP

query: Find flights and hotels for Lisbon departing London on 5 December 2026 returning 9 December 2026, summarise the trip and total cost, then show that total in euros.
expected_behavior: the summary should show the total in EUR alongside the GBP total; should call the currency service to convert GBP to EUR. Expected tools: currency.
preconditions: the Traveller is on the Waypoint welcome screen
a trip summary with a GBP total has been shown
source: trip-summary-and-budget.feature :: The total can be shown in euros on request

query: Hi, I want to plan a holiday
expected_behavior: their message appears in the conversation; an assistant reply appears and fills in progressively; the reply finishes completely
preconditions: the chat is on the welcome screen
source: chat-and-agent-runtime.feature :: Traveller sends a message and receives a streamed reply

expected_behavior: an audit entry of type "decision" appears; the decision entry reads as human-readable text; no audit entry contains hidden model reasoning
source: audit-trail.feature :: A plain conversation records an observable decision entry
smoke_reason: observable audit: decisions, no hidden reasoning
